rules.notes: Recognizes explicitly spelled Result<Vec<_>> collection. No type resolution: aliases, collection inference, closure error constraints and unstable method-name collisions require review. No automatic replacement is provided.

Provides a replacement only when a direct file-level Itertools import exists. It does not prove that collect is the standard iterator method or that the Vec materialization is necessary. Run unnecessary-collection checks first; compile reviewed replacements.

Requires a same-named function parameter explicitly written impl KernelResultIterator<T>; does not infer generic bounds or aliases. It does not resolve local shadowing or mapping-function capture/evaluation equivalence.

Recognizes an immediately joined temporary Vec and a string-literal separator. Review item Display/Borrow equivalence, imports and destruction timing. A retained or reused Vec is deliberately not matched.

Specialized field_names().cloned().collect().join() suggestion. A reviewer must confirm Kernel StructType::field_names returns borrowed Strings; similarly named methods are not resolved by AST matching.

Flags only explicit Result::ok / Result::into_iter error-erasing adapters. It intentionally does not flag generic flatten() or Option pipelines. Intentional best-effort processing may keep the code with an explicit policy; different result-preserving adapters are not interchangeable fixes.

Recognizes directly collected fallible pairs immediately consumed by unzip. The equivalent process_results consumer drains input, but output inference, allocation layout and partial-value Drop order need semantic review.

Recognizes a two-element let-else slice pattern over split(char).collect::<Vec<_>>(). Review source type and iterator purity: collect_tuple checks exact arity but consumes fewer excess items. Reject extra delimiters as before; split_once alone is not equivalent.

Recognizes a narrow Ok/Err match retaining every error. Review Result constructor resolution, Itertools availability and mapping-function captures before using the supplied replacement. Side-effectful match arms do not match.
